description: Issue the user's HeroX quote right here in the chat: the full line-by-line quote comes back in the result (show it to the user; they do not need to visit any website), plus an optional web copy. For air domes the quote is priced by the HeroX pricing engine, with a web copy at quotes.heroxairdomes.com/q/... (line items, options they can tick, terms, valid 60 days); for frame halls, a project page sent to HeroX for a firm price. The HeroX team is notified, confirms the price after site engineering and contacts the user within 1 business day. Only call after (1) you have shown the price, (2) the user gave their own name, email, city and country in this conversation, and (3) the user explicitly agreed to send them to HeroX (user_confirmed true). Never invent contact details. conversation_summary: 3-8 sentences on goals, site, sport, timeline, budget, decision makers and open questions, so the HeroX call starts informed. Returns the quote link to give the user. Always tell the user the quote is an AI-assisted estimate that HeroX confirms before it is binding.

financed.description: Use HeroX financing (10% down, 8% APR) on the HeroX scope.

rate_per_court_hour_usd.description: Rental price per court-hour (field-hour for soccer). Defaults by sport and region.

climate.description: Sizes the heating: hot (Dubai), mild (Brussels), cold (New York), veryCold (Columbus OH), extremelyCold (Montreal). Pick the closest to the site.

courts.description: Number of courts (or fields / pools). Used to size the dome when dimensions are unknown.

include_mechanical.description: Air domes only: include the inflation and heating unit (false if an existing unit is reused).

length_ft.description: Footprint length in feet, if known.

length_m.description: Footprint length in metres (alternative to feet).

region.description: north_america is quoted in USD and feet; everywhere else in EUR and metres.

spec.description: seasonal = single layer, winter-only; standard = double layer; insulated = year-round insulated (most common in cold climates); premium = highest insulation.

structure_type.description: air_dome = air-supported (inflated) dome; frame_hall = aluminium-frame fabric building (no inflation, openable sides possible).

width_ft.description: Footprint width in feet, if known.

width_m.description: Footprint width in metres (alternative to feet).

user_confirmed.description: True only if the user explicitly agreed to send their details to HeroX.

name: create_quote
title: Issue a HeroX quote (AI-assisted estimate)
